Jesse (Summit Retail): Heads up — we're rolling the Pricing and Returns teams onto the platform next month. They'll want embeddings for product matching + chat assistants for ops. Current plan seats won't cover both. Anyone free to advise on capacity and quick enablement?

Maya (CSM): Thanks Jesse — congrats on the rollout! Do you have rough qps / monthly token estimates for each team? Also: renewal is in Oct, so this is timely. :eyes:

Jesse (Summit Retail): Pricing team ~300k tokens/day (mostly embeddings + some generation), Returns ~120k tokens/day but high burst during returns windows (peaks ~600 concurrent requests for chat).

Lara (AE): Noted. We should look at Dedicated vs burst credits. If renewal is Oct we can include a seat uplift discount if they commit to reserved capacity. I'll pull current usage + forecast.

Bea (SE): For their burst profile I'd recommend a small Dedicated pool with autoscale burst + prefix/KV caching for pricing embeddings. Also consider 8-bit quantized model for embeddings to lower cost. Quick question: are embeddings per-request or batched?

Jesse (Summit Retail): Embeddings are per-request from UI and a nightly bulk reindex (~2M items). They also do product similarity lookups on every search.

Noah (Onboarding): We can run a focused enablement for both teams next week — 45m hands-on: SDKs, batching tips, and how to integrate prefix cache. Suggested slots Tue/Wed 9-11 PT. Which works?

Maya (CSM): I'll coordinate. Also tagging in a small prompt/regression harness so they can catch quality changes post-quantization. Is there any PII going to these models? Need to confirm data residency and KMS requirements before Private deployment discussion.

Jesse (Summit Retail): No PII in embeddings, product SKUs + descriptions only. But returns team wants audit logs for dispute investigations.

Bea (SE): Ok — audit logs are available on Private/Dedicated with extended retention. For Hosted we can push logs via webhook to their SIEM. Quick config snippet for batching we usually share:
```
client.generate({
  model: "rwd-embed-quantized-v1",
  batchSize: 64,
  maxLatencyMs: 50
})
```
This reduces cost for the nightly reindex and keeps UI latency low with async fallback.

Lara (AE): FYI Jesse — if you sign a 12m reserved commit for a small Dedicated pool we can price the extra teams as seats + token cap, and shift some of the nightly reindex to off-peak to reduce peak cost. I'll DM pricing options. :money_with_wings:

Maya (CSM): Next steps: 1) Confirm preferred enablement slot (Jesse) 2) Share per-team forecast spreadsheet (Lara) 3) Decide if they want Hosted with webhook logs or Dedicated for native audit/log retention (Jesse) 4) SE to run a short perf test simulating 600 concurrent chat connections.

Jesse (Summit Retail): Tue 9am PT works. I'll bring the returns lead. We prefer Hosted first if logs -> SIEM works, but will consider Dedicated if audit requirements tighten. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

Bea (SE): I'll schedule a perf test for Mon EOD and post results here. Can you send a sample workload (jsonl) for the concurrency test?

Noah (Onboarding): Slot booked Tue 9am PT. I'll send calendar invite + prework (SDK install + sample reindex job).

Maya (CSM): Great — I'll prep a renewal note for Oct with expansion signal (2 new teams, expected +420k tokens/day, burst concurrency) so AM/Sales can loop in finance.

DeployBot: Deployment 2871 succeeded to prod (model catalog update) — added rwd-embed-quantized-v1.

Lara (AE): I'll put together a short proposal by EOD Friday for seat pricing + reserved capacity options.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team — follow-ups: Lara (pricing doc), Bea (perf test), Noah (invite), Jesse (workload sample). Marking as actioned here. :white_check_mark:
